purpose.summary: This is the master menu controller (ORCGM00) for the ORCA JMA Standard Receipt (medical billing) software system. It handles screen initialization, screen transitions, operator authentication, system date setup, infection-disease reporting triggers, and linkage to various subsystem screens (M00–M99 series). It acts as the top-level menu dispatcher for the medical practice management application.

verdict.notes: The file is decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments, resulting in mojibake in the displayed text. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software project. The MCP interface (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WINDOW) is ORCA's own screen/transaction middleware, not standard CICS, though the program_type is analogous to an online transaction program.
